# Grammar, not drift (the Burmese dictionary form follows the Pāli form): finite verbs by tense (ghāy, suṇ, sāy, phus, paṭihaññ, uppajj, bhav: Bhavissati, kaṅkh: kaṅkhati, ottapp: ottappati, bhāv: bhāveti, āhār: āhāreti); purpose datives in «…ရန်» (anuppād, pahān, saṃvar, yāpan, ṭhit: ṭhitiyā, patt: pattiyā, uppād: uppādāya, vihār: vihāraṃ); absolutives in «…၍» (abhiññ: abhiññā in «sayaṃ abhiññā», vivicc); attributive vs noun (appaṇihit, suññat: -aṃ/-anti attributive, -a/-ā the noun of the heading compounds; nīl, odāt, pīt: colour noun vs «…သော» adjective; hīn: hīno «ယုတ်ညံ့သူ» the person; sat: sato; saññ: saññī; arūp: arūpino «ရုပ် မဟုတ်သော» vs the plane Arūpa «ရုပ်မရှိသော»; vipāk: vipākā / vipākāni adjective; jāt: jāti noun; maraṇ: maraṇā «after death»; att: attato «as self»; gāh: gāhī agent); dyad-term forms (dhammā saṃyojan, saṃyojan, nīvaraṇ, upādān: -iyā «…၏ အာရုံ ဖြစ်နိုင်သော»).

# Senses kept from the senses file: bahiddhā ×3, kāya ×2 (body / mental body), rūpa (fine-material / visible form / matter), dukkha ×3, sukha (easy / pleasure), maggo / maggaṃ (path / way), Chanda, cetasika (adjective / mental factor), phala (fruit / fruition), hetū (root / cause), sineho (affection / cohesion), dhamma (phenomenon / teaching), sacca (true / truth), sammā (right / perfectly), niyatā, vāro, sampaggāho, thambhitattaṃ, bhedo, brahma, khandha (trunk / aggregate), āyatanāni (sense base / sphere), āhāraṃ (nutriment / food), kiriyā (functional / doing), vaṇṇa (colour / praise), saṅkhārena (prompting), saṅkha (conch) / saṅkhā (reckoning), lohitaka, kaṭuka, nett (guide / leash), gām / gat / man / manāp / puris / satt / sut / aññ / aṭṭhān / vijj (different Pāli words or uses under one stem: e.g. gāmo «ရွာ», manussa «လူ», sattu «မုယောမှုန့်», vijju «လျှပ်စီး», aṭṭhāne «without reason»).

# Kept on purpose: kusalato / akusalato / akusalesu / vipākato / kiriyato / kiriyesu = classes of mind in the chapter-5 planes lists («X စိတ်», the tags say «from among the X minds»), while kusalaṃ / akusalaṃ / kusalesu and the other forms keep the core adjective ကုသိုလ် / အကုသိုလ်; indriyānaṃ / indriyesu «အာရုံခံ အင်္ဂါ» (the senses, approved Mātikā item) vs indriya of the 22 faculties «စွမ်းရည်»; cittuppāda / uppāda: the approved chapter title Cittuppāda «စိတ် ဖြစ်ပေါ်ခြင်း» vs the counted kinds of chapter 5 «စိတ် ဖြစ်ပေါ်မှု ရှစ်ပါး» (countable noun); viññāṇañca «အဆုံး မရှိသော သိစိတ်» (the immaterial base), dassanena «သစ္စာကို မြင်ခြင်း» (approved Mātikā: the first path) vs dassanaṃ «မြင်ခြင်း»; nay: naye / Catukkanayo / Pañcakanayo «ခွဲနည်း» (jhāna counting) vs nayā «နည်း» (Vīsati mahānayā, methods of exposition).
